description: This file implements a class for managing and selecting the deployment with the lowest TPM (Tokens Per Minute) and RPM (Requests Per Minute) usage, including logging and cache management for deployment strategies in a machine learning inference environment.

classes.name: RoutingArgs
classes.description: A Pydantic model class defining routing arguments, specifically TTL for cache expiration.

classes.name: LowestTPMLoggingHandler
classes.description: A logger and deployment selector class that tracks TPM/RPM usage, updates cache, and selects the deployment with the lowest usage.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event, updating TPM and RPM counters in cache synchronously.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event, updating TPM and RPM counters in cache.

methods.name: get_available_deployments
methods.description: Selects and returns the deployment with the lowest TPM/RPM usage based on current cache and usage metrics.
